identity_families.semantic_source: Mount namespace plus exact mount relation; mountinfo mount ID, parent ID, major:minor, root, mountpoint and filesystem kind are candidates, not historical observations.
identity_families.semantic_role: Exact /tmp or /work mount incarnation, also referenced by writer handles. Numeric mount ID is a reusable namespace-local relation, not standalone incarnation proof.
identity_families.admission: Existing id: 1..256 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; reject unrepresentable evidence, never truncate.

identity_families.semantic_source: Mount namespace observation plus authenticated generation and continuity.
identity_families.semantic_role: Per-mount stale namespace replacement protection. A raw namespaces.mnt alias would identify the observed namespace but cannot alone prove nonreplacement across an unobserved gap; no alias or hidden counter is adopted.
identity_families.admission: Existing id: 1..256 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; reject unrepresentable evidence, never truncate.

identity_families.semantic_source: No-follow root st_dev, st_ino, file type and exact mount relation, bound to current authenticated generation.
identity_families.semantic_role: Exact root object of each tmpfs mount. Device/inode may be reused; metadata mode/uid/gid/link_count are separate observations, not identity inputs. Root path or device equality does not establish no-cross-mount.
identity_families.admission: Existing id: 1..256 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; reject unrepresentable evidence, never truncate.

identity_families.semantic_source: PID in observer PID-numbering view; process stat field 22 starttime; target active PID namespace; authenticated container/workspace/controller generation.
identity_families.semantic_role: Both fields must reference the SAME inventoried original controller process on the lower profile. A full process projection is distinct from start_identity alone. Tuple/digest choice deferred: a digest cannot repair noninjective facts or missing continuity.
identity_families.admission: Existing id: 1..256 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; reject unrepresentable evidence, never truncate.

identity_families.semantic_role: Aggregate equality key for the entire seven-namespace observation. Individual fields remain interpretable kernel facts. A changed component changes the preimage; digest equality alone is neither authentication nor namespace incarnation continuity.
identity_families.admission: Existing id: 1..256 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; reject unrepresentable evidence, never truncate.

identity_families.semantic_source: Exact bytes of the complete /proc/<pid>/cgroup observation (historical source preserves file text; the new byte preimage is an explicit additive decision).

identity_families.semantic_role: Equality projection of the observed membership listing in its observation/PID/cgroup namespace context. Does not prove same underlying cgroup object after path reuse, rename, recreation or namespace replacement.

identity_families.semantic_source: Field 22 starttime in /proc/<pid>/stat: elapsed boot clock ticks at process start, not wall time.
identity_families.canonical_representation: Unsigned canonical decimal text: 0|[1-9][0-9]*; one JSON string, not a JSON integer.
identity_families.semantic_role: Exact starttime FACT only, scoped by enclosing pid, active PID namespace, original process and authenticated generation. Tick quantization is not proven collision-free; no PID+tick uniqueness claim.
identity_families.admission: Existing id: 1..256 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; reject unrepresentable evidence, never truncate.

identity_families.semantic_source: Field 22 of /proc/<pid>/task/<tid>/stat for that task; do not copy the leader's value.
identity_families.canonical_representation: Unsigned canonical decimal text: 0|[1-9][0-9]*; one JSON string, not a JSON integer.
identity_families.semantic_role: Task's own starttime FACT, scoped by tid and enclosing original process/PID namespace/generation. Distinct role from writer.task_identity; no TID-only or tick-only incarnation assertion.
identity_families.admission: Existing id: 1..256 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; reject unrepresentable evidence, never truncate.

identity_families.semantic_source: Enclosing original process relation plus exact task TID, task stat starttime and PID namespace in current generation.
identity_families.semantic_role: Join one writer record to its inventoried task incarnation; do not alias task.start_identity alone. Missing continuity proof is not solved by tuple concatenation.
identity_families.admission: Existing id: 1..256 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; reject unrepresentable evidence, never truncate.

identity_families.semantic_source: Observed PGID, admitted compiler child and original leader process incarnation/start/PID namespace, bound to the same admitted operation and generation.
identity_families.semantic_role: Capture/reap evidence for the exact admitted child/group. Historical start_new_session makes child PID the group selector, but PGID alone or a recreated same-PGID group cannot be accepted. Preserve retained relation through leader exit/reaping; this phase issues no token.
identity_families.admission: Existing id: 1..256 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; reject unrepresentable evidence, never truncate.

identity_families.semantic_source: access_kind selects actual open_writable_handle or synthetic potential_write_access relation.
identity_families.semantic_role: Both kinds exist in the frozen schema. Actual FD requires exact process/task + observed descriptor slot + coherent observation/mount/object relation; close/reopen reuses a number. Potential access is not an FD and needs its independently defined relation semantics. No tagged grammar is frozen until both preimages are truthful; no record counts/topology/potential-access rules are decided.
identity_families.admission: Existing id: 1..256 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; reject unrepresentable evidence, never truncate.

numeric_families.semantic_source: Full int(st_mode), including file type, special and permission bits; never stat.S_IMODE. Check file type against kind, reject special files and links. Root must be directory. Metadata is not object identity.
numeric_families.representation: Exact built-in int; ordinary canonical JSON decimal. No bool, float, sign on nonnegative values, leading zeros, exponent, octal, quotes or coercion.
numeric_families.range_basis: Existing uint/positive_int schema admission; not a claimed native Linux kernel type width.
numeric_families.mode_width_basis: Allowed Linux regular-file/directory full type bits require at least five decimal digits; schema-only upper envelope remains 19. No permissions-only alternative.

distinction: Semantic kernel maxima, admitted wire ceilings, grammar lower bounds, actual attainable widths and symbolic budget placeholders are separate. No unspecified one-byte identity is asserted attainable.
